{{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Marris.png|thumb|250px|Marris]] '''Marris''' (Japanese: '''モリシマ''' ''Morishima'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She first appeared in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where she participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and was {{Ash}}'s first opponent. However, she was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament. She made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where she lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]] and [[Freddy O'Martian]]. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |width=68% |trainer=Marris |pkmn=Karrablast |img=Marris Karrablast.png |type1=Bug |epnum=BW090 |epname=Jostling for the Junior Cup! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld |desc={{p|Karrablast}} is the only Pokémon Marris is known to have on hand. It was used in the first round of the Junior Cup but lost to [[Ash's Leavanny]]. None of Karrablast's moves are known.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Marris has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] - Top 16 (''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{bug color}}|bordercolor={{bug color light}} |en=[[Hilary Thomas]] |es_eu=María Blanco}}
